texts.query:1: How do I bake a cake?
texts.doc:dog: A dog chases a ball across the park on a sunny afternoon.
texts.doc:recipe: Whisk the eggs with sugar, then fold in the flour to make the cake batter.
texts.doc:budget: The quarterly budget review moved the marketing spend into the next fiscal year.
texts.doc:stars: Astronomers photographed a spiral galaxy two hundred million light years away.
texts.doc:bike: Fixing a flat bicycle tire takes a patch kit, a pump and ten minutes.
texts.doc:cat: The cat slept on the warm windowsill while rain tapped the glass.
